findings.evidence: The proof uses only `coeFn_compLpL`, `Lp.coeFn_smul` and `map_smul`; nothing in it depends on Cauchy or Beurling.
findings.fix: Make it a public `ContinuousLinearMap` lemma, generic in `𝕜` and `μ`, in `TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Function/Lp/FiniteDimensional.lean` next to `eq_sum_basis_compLpL`.
findings.issue: `functional_span` (`ℓ.compLpL (toSpanSingleton v).compLpL u = ℓ v • u`) is a general Lp identity that only mentions Mathlib types, yet it is `private` in the Cauchy file.

findings.evidence: Searching Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function and TauCeti for `compLpL_comp|comp_compLpL|compLpL_compLpL` found only the unrelated `isCompactOperator_of_forall_isCompactOperator_compLpL_comp` and `evalCLM_compLpL_comp_lpPi`.
findings.fix: Export it as a public `ContinuousLinearMap.compLpL_comp` for arbitrary `μ` and `𝕜` in the Lp infrastructure.
findings.issue: `post_comp` (`ℓ.compLpL (L.compLpL u) = (ℓ.comp L).compLpL u`) is the general functoriality of `compLpL` under composition. It is hidden as `private` and specialised to `volume` on ℂ.

findings.evidence: Nothing in `lineL` or its lemmas depends on the Cauchy operator. The existing graph infrastructure has only the real rank-one map `smulRightW1pL` (`GraphStep/Density.lean:97`), with no complex-scalar version.
findings.fix: Move `lineL` and both lemmas to `TauCeti/Analysis/Sobolev/GraphStep/Coordinates.lean` as public API, next to `smulRightW1pL`, `toW1pL` and `value_toW1pL`.
findings.issue: `lineL`, the lift of a complex scalar weak-derivative graph along `v : F` on any `Ω : Opens ℂ`, is general Sobolev graph infrastructure. It is `private`, and so are its characterising lemmas `lineL_prev` (line 547) and `lineL_weakFDeriv_ae` (line 578).

summary: General infrastructure is hidden as `private` in the Cauchy file: two Lp `compLpL` identities and the rank-one complex-to-vector graph lift `lineL` with its value and derivative lemmas. The rest of the surface has hidden bodies and suitable `@[simp]` tags.
